note.title: Competition and limiting factors
note.overview: Competition occurs when organisms need the same limited resource; it may be within or between species.

Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.

mustMemoriseRules: Intraspecific: same species; interspecific: different species.
Animals compete for food, water, space and mates; plants compete for light, water, space and mineral ions.
Population growth slows as limiting factors strengthen.
